neighbours.label: the piece after 'super' in super- compounds (super|l|ative, super|gravity)
fire: Critics used every superlative they could find for the new film.

Her superlative performance won the jury over.
The theory combines supersymmetry with gravity.
Reporters avoided superlatives when describing the deal.
His superlative skill on the violin amazed the hall.
The lecture covered supergravity and string theory.
